blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) – Region 11 (Davao Region) served a subpoena to the Department of Public Works and Highways-11 (DPWH-11) on Monday, directing the agency to produce documents related to some 50 allegedly questionable flood-control and road projects in the region, mostly in Davao City. The documents being sought include projects awarded to Genesis88 Construction Inc., which is owned by businessman Glen Escandor. Escandor had donated campaign funds to Sara Duterte during the vice presidential race in 2022, a PCIJ report said.
